name: smwmusic-pok-mon-red-blue-yellow-professor-oak-s-laboratory
title: Pokémon Red/Blue/Yellow - Professor Oak's Laboratory
description:
Unsampled port of the song that plays inside Professor Oak's laboratory in the first generation Pokémon games (Red, Blue and Yellow)

Fits tutorial levels and cutscenes (there's no tutorial tag in the official tags list though).

Update: Lowered #2's octave to o3.
Update 2: Added ADSR and remote commands (which made the insert size increase to 0x194 bytes).
